title: Learning Account Overview
description: ローカル学習Account専用。実namespace: __ACCOUNT_NAMESPACE__。SDKのlegacy互換値は実namespace表示に使いません。単一instance、SDK鮮度90秒。履歴は再起動で消失。

panels.title: 収集状態
panels.description: 0: 収集不可/新鮮さ未確認、1: SDK正常・要求系列の準備中、2: 通信なし、3: 通信あり。単一Account instance前提。Prometheus障害はError/No data。

0.text: 収集不可 / 新鮮さ未確認

3.text: 収集正常 / 通信あり

targets.expr: (vector(0) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 0)) or ((vector(1) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)) unless on() sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m]))) or (vector(2) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1) and on() (sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) == 0)) or (vector(3) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1) and on() (sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) > 0))

panels.title: 要求数の推定 / 5m
panels.description: increaseの外挿による推定数。curl回数の厳密な実数ではありません。health probe除外。

targets.expr: sum(increase(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)

panels.title: 要求 / 秒
panels.description: instanceごとにrate後sumし、counter resetを処理。通信なしは0、収集不可はN/A。

targets.expr: sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)

panels.title: HTTPエラー率 (4xx + 5xx)
panels.description: 4xxはclient、5xxはserverのエラー。無通信や収集不可を0%へ変換しません。

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend",status_class=~"4xx|5xx"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m]))) and on() (sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)

panels.title: 応答時間 p95
panels.description: 固定histogram bucketによる推定、単位は秒。無通信/収集不可はN/A。

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(pe_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="account-backend"}[5m]))) and on() (sum(rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)

panels.title: status_class別 要求 / 秒
panels.description: 安全な400要求を4xxとして確認。5xxを起こすためにDBを停止しません。

targets.expr: sum by (status_class) (rate(pe_http_server_requests_total{job="account-backend"}[5m])) and on() ((((min(up{job="otel-application"}) == bool 1) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) < bool 90) * on() ((time() - max(timestamp(pe_go_goroutines{job="account-backend"}))) >= bool 0)) or vector(0)) == 1)
